final.name: Recitation of the submitter organization's size or market share
final.audit_justification: Reciting size/market-share is self-credentialing rather than argument content, though better-resourced organizations plausibly also produce more substantive analysis.

final.name: Decisive, unambiguous stated position
final.audit_justification: A clear, unambiguous stance is itself decision-useful substantive content for the agency, not a stylistic or production fingerprint.

final.name: Mechanistic causal reasoning
final.audit_justification: Explaining intermediate causal effects of a policy is core substantive reasoning.

final.name: Signatory's seniority title paired with a direct personal contact line
final.audit_justification: A senior title plus contact info is a status/credentialing marker explicitly divorced from whether the argument is correct, though seniority may correlate with genuine subject-matter authority.

final.name: Engages the merits versus requesting only a schedule change
final.audit_justification: It measures whether the comment engages the substance of the rule at all versus being purely procedural, explicitly excluding writing quality or formatting.

final.name: Distributional impact analysis
final.audit_justification: Connecting a proposal to concrete distributional effects on identifiable groups is substantive analytical content.

final.name: Information Gain
final.audit_justification: Directly measures whether the comment adds facts, analysis, or examples beyond a bare position -- the definition of substantive content.

final.name: Overall length and verbosity of the submission
final.audit_justification: Sheer text volume is explicitly scored independent of content quality; however greater effort/resources could plausibly drive both length and genuine substance.

final.name: Timing and urgency cues
final.audit_justification: Surface mentions of deadlines or urgency are a temporal tell scored regardless of whether the urgency is justified, with no plausible link to argument substance.
final.upstream_parent: submission timing and available preparation time

final.name: Personal and local grounding
final.audit_justification: The criterion scores mere presence of first-person/local-experience markers and explicitly disclaims judging whether that experience makes the comment good, but real local experience plausibly also grounds genuinely better analysis.

final.name: Brevity that resolves to a clear disposition from a positioned party
final.audit_justification: It measures whether a short comment nonetheless conveys a recoverable, decision-relevant position, which is informational substance rather than a style or production marker.

final.name: Traceable evidence use
final.audit_justification: Tying claims to identifiable studies, records, or standards is a direct evidence-quality measure.

final.name: Interest disclosed, and the argument survives the interest
final.audit_justification: It tests whether the argument holds independent of the commenter's self-interest, which is a measure of argumentative soundness rather than a production fingerprint.

final.name: Temporal and comparative context
final.audit_justification: Using historical or comparative context to clarify why a proposal matters is substantive analytical framing, distinct from a mere date/urgency tell.

final.name: OCR and scan-degradation noise
final.audit_justification: Scan/OCR corruption is a pure artifact of document production pipeline and the criterion explicitly forbids treating it as evidence about quality, carelessness, or resources.
final.upstream_parent: document-production and submission medium (fax or paper scan versus a native electronic file)

final.name: Concrete regulatory exposure, not generic organizational self-description
final.audit_justification: It rewards concrete, checkable facts linking the commenter's specific assets or operations to the rule's actual reach, which is substantive checkable content rather than a status marker.

final.name: Written for this docket versus repurposed campaign or marketing copy
final.audit_justification: This scores the genre/register of the writing (docket-addressed versus repurposed campaign copy), explicitly excluding the position taken or its sincerity, though genuinely engaged writers plausibly also produce better-tailored substance.
final.arbiter_reason: The discriminating cues are register and provenance markers -- consumer second-person address, headline openers, action-alert closes, repeated rhetorical questions -- and the instruction explicitly forbids judging the position or its substance, so it detects that the text was produced by a distributed advocacy campaign rather than measuring what the comment contributes to the record. It is mixed because a commenter who writes for this specific docket plausibly also engages the rule's substance more closely.

final.name: Firsthand Operational Knowledge
final.audit_justification: It requires the author's experience to be explicitly connected to specific policy effects, which is substantive analytical use of that experience.

final.name: Explicit causal chain from fact to recommended consequence
final.audit_justification: An explicit 'because X, therefore Y' chain from fact to recommendation is core substantive reasoning.

final.name: Institutional status cues
final.audit_justification: It scores explicit signaling of office, title, or organizational scale while disclaiming whether the signal is deserved or relevant, though genuine institutional standing may also correlate with informed content.

final.name: Boilerplate language
final.audit_justification: Stock openings, closings, and repeated formulaic passages are template/production markers unrelated to substance.

final.name: Submission artifact markers
final.audit_justification: Attachment placeholders, email headers, and fax/upload artifacts are transmission-pipeline fingerprints with no bearing on argument content.

final.name: Coalition breadth
final.audit_justification: Naming multiple joint commenters or member networks is a scale/coalition-breadth marker scored regardless of representativeness or persuasiveness, though broader coalition-building may also reflect more vetted, substantive positions.

final.name: Stated expertise is used to generate a specific insight, not just asserted
final.audit_justification: It specifically distinguishes a credential that generates a non-obvious technical point from one merely asserted alongside generic content, directly testing substantive use of expertise.

final.name: Net information flow: contributes to the record or draws from it
final.audit_justification: Whether a comment nets out as contributing evidence/analysis versus only demanding information from the agency is a direct measure of substantive contribution to the record.
